fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name

fields.label: Environments

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Internal name of the API product.

fields.label: Org ID
fields.help: The Apigee Organization associated with the Apigee API product, in the format 'organizations/{{org_name}}'.

fields.label: Proxies
fields.help: Comma-separated list of API proxy names to which this API product is bound.

fields.label: Quota
fields.help: Number of request messages permitted per app by this API product for the specified quotaInterval and quotaTimeUnit.

fields.label: Quota Counter Scope
fields.help: Scope of the quota decides how the quota counter gets applied and evaluate for quota violation.

fields.label: Quota Interval
fields.help: Time interval over which the number of request messages is calculated.

fields.label: Quota Time Unit
fields.help: Time unit defined for the quotaInterval.

fields.label: Scopes
